title: argv and env

blocks.promptMd: After `node` and the script path, `process.argv` holds your {{a}}. `process.env.LAWP_FLAG` is an {{b}} value.
blocks.explainMd: argv is the command line. env is a separate bag. This run sets LAWP_FLAG and passes --scrub.

blocks.promptMd: > Print `scrub` only when `process.argv` includes `--scrub` **and** `process.env.LAWP_FLAG === "scrub"`. Otherwise `"none"`. Do not hard-code `return "scrub"`.

hintLadder.md: The runner passed `--scrub` and set `LAWP_FLAG`. Read both — not a hardcoded string.
Return `"scrub"` only when both are true; otherwise `"none"`.

description: A program can read the words you typed and the environment around it.
